notes.title: Hardwired Demo V0.1.0 - Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
New Gameplay Option: The generator can now be exploded under certain conditions – try it and see what happens!

Generator Command Interface Update: Interacting with the generator is now more intuitive.

Better NPC Behavior: Updated navigation and NPC behavior logic.

New Settings Options: Toggle the CRT effect, adjust mouse sensitivity.

Visual Improvements: Improved subtitles and removed visual artefacts.

Audio Enhancements: Support of multiple simultaneous audio effects.

Optimized CPU Load.
